# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using `scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py`.

## Case Selection

- **No-filter default**: When `--case` is omitted, all cases in the test suite run in their original suite order.
- **Filtering & Suite Order**: You can select specific cases using one or more `--case` flags (e.g., `python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --case alpha --case gamma`). Selected cases are executed in their original suite order regardless of the order in which `--case` flags are passed.
- **Duplicates**: Duplicate `--case` flags (e.g., passing `--case alpha` multiple times) are automatically deduplicated so each named case runs once.
- **Unknown IDs**: Unknown case IDs fail immediately (raising an error before creating output directories or executing any cases).

arguments.content:
# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py.

## Case Selection

You can select specific cases to run using the `--case` flag multiple times.

Example:
```
python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --binary /path/to/binary --repo /path/to/repo --out /path/to/output --provider openai --model offline --case alpha --case gamma
```

This will run only the cases with IDs `alpha` and `gamma` in the original suite order.

- Repeated `--case` flags selecting the same case ID will only run that case once.
- Cases are always run in the original suite order defined in the spec, regardless of the order of `--case` flags.
- If no `--case` flags are provided, all cases run by default.
- If any unknown case IDs are specified, the program will fail immediately with an error before producing output or running any cases.

This behavior preserves the original suite order and prevents duplicate runs or unknown case execution.

## Output Directory

The output directory must not exist before running the pilot to avoid overwriting existing results.

arguments.content:
# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using `scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py`.

## Case selection

- Without `--case`, all cases run in their original suite order.
- With `--case`, only the specified case IDs run, in the original suite order. Repeated flags are allowed; duplicates are ignored and the original order is preserved.
- Unknown case IDs cause an immediate error before any output or execution.

### Example

```bash
scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --case alpha --case gamma
```

This runs only the `alpha` and `gamma` cases, in the order they appear in the suite, ignoring any duplicates.
